odooPage.title: Odoo – Centralized Business Management.
odooPage.subtitle: Centralize your business operations with Odoo. INTER-IT Services supports you in analyzing your requirements, configuring modules, and setting up a management environment tailored to your organization.

whatIs.title: Why Centralize Your Operations with Odoo?
whatIs.description: Odoo is an integrated suite of business management applications that brings all your organization's core functions together into a single environment. By eliminating fragmentation across disconnected tools, you gain clear visibility, reduce duplicate data entry, and simplify daily teamwork.

modules.title: Areas Covered
modules.subtitle: We configure and adapt the core Odoo modules essential to managing your operations:

items.name: CRM and sales management
items.desc: Centralized lead management, structured tracking of commercial opportunities, and complete customer interaction history.

items.name: Sales and purchasing
items.desc: Fast quotation issuing, customer order validation, and streamlined supplier purchase order management.

items.name: Invoicing and accounting
items.desc: Invoice generation, rigorous payment follow-up, bank reconciliation, and clear financial monitoring.

items.name: Inventory management
items.desc: Accurate stock level tracking, traceability of receipts and deliveries, and replenishment management.

items.name: Project management
items.desc: Task organization, operational progress tracking, resource planning, and deadline control.

items.name: Centralized operations
items.desc: Unification of your business processes within a single, coherent environment shared across your teams.

process.title: Our Implementation Support
process.subtitle: INTER-IT Services guides you through every stage to put in place an Odoo environment tailored to your organization:

steps.title: Business needs analysis
steps.desc: Comprehensive gathering and analysis of your objectives, operational structure, and management challenges.

steps.title: Study of existing processes
steps.desc: Detailed review of your current operational workflows to design a coherent implementation.

steps.title: Selection of relevant modules
steps.desc: Identification of the Odoo modules that directly address your organization's real needs.

steps.title: Configuration and parameterization
steps.desc: Configuring your environment, business rules, user access permissions, and document templates.

steps.title: Testing and validation
steps.desc: Thorough verification of all configured workflows prior to operational launch.

steps.title: Go-live support and onboarding
steps.desc: System launch and practical hands-on onboarding so your teams can use the platform confidently.

steps.title: Follow-up and continuous improvement
steps.desc: Regular post-launch follow-up to adjust and evolve your system as your organization grows.
